Fixes.CR-001: Keep listening after a cancelled close; acknowledge only actual shutdown. Retry regression reproduced before the fix and passes after it.
Fixes.CR-002: Merge latest desired Windows sample rates in both online and offline captures. Offline save, preset export/import, restart, and disconnected endpoint preservation pass.
Fixes.CR-003: Only bind a unique ID/name candidate; keep ambiguous and missing bindings unresolved. Do not guess another microphone or block unrelated buses.
Fixes.CR-004: Clean each owned download workspace on failure/cancellation and after installer exit. Wait for active installer completion before cleanup; cancel signature-verification subprocess before deleting its input.

InstallerCleanupCases: Local installer fixture retains payload while running, even after cancellation request
Payload removed only after installer exits
Limitations: No end-to-end UAC or real Banana installer UI test was performed.
Forced process termination or OS shutdown during installation is outside the normal cleanup tests.
Historical unmarked temporary directories are not removed by broad prefix matching.
